## more.slot Test 5

This is the next more.slot test build, rebuilt on UnsloT's H700 system and menu foundation.

- Adds the Game Gear with PicoDrive as the default core, a dedicated Game Gear LCD shader and color correction, and a separate Game Gear bezel set.
- Uses the Game Gear cartridge artwork and clear shell treatment on the shelf and in the slot.
- Carries the existing English/German handheld language selector into this build.
- Keeps the Test 4 ZIP update path for the first upgrade. Later more.slot builds use the same isolated test OTA feed.

This is a test release. It does not change the stable select.slot release or update feed.
